title: Identify European Soil compact metadata
changes: Authenticate a compact metadata projection linked to the 20 already owned Soil Evidence sprite lists.
validation: Wine source-site capture e274-soil-compact-sites-wine-d95mdss3 observes all 88 metadata bytes over 600 E235 frames; static plan e274-soil-compact-metadata-plan-tmxn23ol verifies 20 list references, selector 0 and 20 frame references without overlapping existing owners.
limitations: The projection does not establish producer, complete selector/index domain, all readers or scenes; instruction scopes may include nested accesses. The plan publishes no owner and existing list bytes must not be declared twice.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance comparison was performed.
